**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A white square plate, roughly 20 cm across. Area ≈ 314 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Cooked bacon, two to three folded strips
- Pineapple chunks, about 6-7 pieces
- No visible sauce or oil pool, apart from a little bacon fat

**STEP 4 - Area:**
- Bacon: ~10% of the plate (~31 cm²)
- Pineapple: ~15% of the plate (~47 cm²)
- Total covered: ~25%, so most of the plate is empty.

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Bacon: 31 cm² × 0.4 cm ≈ 12 ml
- Pineapple: 47 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 94 ml

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Bacon: 12 ml × 0.9 ≈ 11 g. Folded strips are denser than that, so I round up to 15 g.
- Pineapple: 94 ml × 0.6 ≈ 56 g, rounded to 60 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Bacon, cooked: 15 g × 540 kcal/100 g ≈ 81 kcal
- Pineapple: 60 g × 50 kcal/100 g = 30 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A plate with a few bacon strips and about six pineapple chunks, covering only a quarter of the plate, should weigh well under 100 g. A total of about 75 g and about 110 kcal is plausible.
